Services

What the salon does

From the Fresha menu and what clients write in their Google reviews.

Cut and blow-dry

Haircuts with blow-dry and styling, and help when a cut from somewhere else came out uneven.

Colour and roots

Colouring, highlights, root touch-ups and colour correction, from blond to red or back to a natural tone.

Treatments

Hair treatments and smoothing, with heat protection and a close look at the hair before anything is done.

Head massage

A scalp massage at the wash basin that several clients single out in their reviews.

A lounge near Saint Lazarus

Sole Hair Lounge opened in June 2023 on Filosofou in the heart of Larnaca, close to the Church of Saint Lazarus. Orange chairs stand in front of a brick wall and an arched mirror, with plants everywhere. The salon is run by a woman owner and her team, and clients write about warm welcomes, honest advice and a place that feels like home.

What clients say
